spanish: Y el shafán, porque subiente cud él, y pezuña no partirá; impuro él a ustedes.

findings.issue: Definite common noun left as a Hebrew transliteration; common nouns stay Spanish.
Hiphil participle means causing its object to go up; subiente is a simple ascending form and cud is an untranslated English gloss of the feminine singular noun.
The feminine singular hoof is the fronted object; the hiphil imperfect is 3ms with the animal as subject. Spanish reads the hoof as what will not split.
Imperfect is not marked future; partirá resolves the aspect as future.

notes: Y, el, porque, both él, no, impuro, and a ustedes match the conjunction, article, כי, both הוא, לא, טמא, and לכם.
